subject: Request for Work From Home Due to Family Medical Situation
body_plain:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I hope you are doing well.

I wanted to inform you that, due to my father's medical condition, I won't
be able to continue working from the CHOSS office for the time being. I
need to accompany him for frequent hospital visits and unexpected medical
check-ups, making it difficult for me to manage both my family
responsibilities and office attendance.

I would like to request permission to work from home temporarily. This
arrangement will allow me to take care of my father while ensuring that I
continue to fulfill all my work responsibilities without any interruption.

I assure you that I will remain fully available during working hours,
attend all meetings, and complete all assigned tasks on time with the same
level of dedication and commitment.

I kindly request your understanding and approval for this work-from-home
arrangement. Your support during this difficult time would be greatly
appreciated.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to your positive
response.

Yours sincerely,

*Yashwanth Raj D J*
EtherX Innovations Pvt. Ltd.
